findings.current: And on top of that, people belatedly realized that storm clouds were gathering beyond the Great Wall, far to the west.
findings.defect: Adds a westward location that the source does not give.
findings.rationale: 머나먼 describes the distant Great Wall; the passage does not say the threat is west of it.
findings.replacement: And on top of that, people belatedly realized that storm clouds were gathering beyond the distant Great Wall.
findings.source: 그리고 거기에 더하여, 저 머나먼 장성(長城) 밖에서도 먹구름이 몰려들고 있음을 사람들은 뒤늦게 알아차렸다.

findings.current: Unlike the North Sea Ice Palace, which—as always—stuck to the middle path, Nanman Beast Palace had overcome the threat of civil war thanks to the astonishing exploits of a young man and resolved to ally itself with the Murim Alliance.
findings.defect: “Stuck to the middle path” suggests a doctrine rather than the North Sea Ice Palace’s neutral position between sides.
findings.rationale: 중도를 지키고 있는 contrasts the palace’s neutrality with Nanman Beast Palace’s decision to ally with the Murim Alliance.
findings.replacement: Unlike the North Sea Ice Palace, which—as always—remained neutral, Nanman Beast Palace had overcome the threat of civil war thanks to the astonishing exploits of a young man and resolved to ally itself with the Murim Alliance.
findings.source: 언제나 그렇듯이 중도(中道)를 지키고 있는 북해빙궁과 달리, 한 청년의 놀라운 활약으로 내전의 위기를 극복하고 무림맹과 동맹을 결의한 남만야수궁이.

findings.current: Even before the great battle in Gansu began, another group of reinforcements had joined the two bands of outlaws who had secretly gathered in Hubei and Shaanxi.
findings.defect: Places the reinforcements’ arrival before the Gansu battle; that timing describes the bandits’ secret assembly.
findings.rationale: 감숙성에서의 대전투가 벌어지기도 전 modifies the gathering of the two outlaw groups, not when their new support joined them.
findings.replacement: Another force had joined the two bands of outlaws who had secretly gathered around Hubei and Shaanxi even before the great battle in Gansu.
findings.source: 이미 감숙성에서의 대전투가 벌어지기도 전, 은밀하게 호북과 섬서 일대를 중심으로 결집한 두 집단의 도적들에게 또 다른 지원군이 합류했음을.

findings.defect: Turns a deadpan confirmation into an explanation.
findings.rationale: 그렇네 affirms the question, and 지금 repeats its timing.

findings.current: And on top of that, just sitting here, my private parts are starting to tingle…
findings.defect: Moves the sensation from a euphemistically named part of his backside to his genitals.
findings.rationale: 엉덩이의 은밀한 부위 locates the euphemism on his backside; “private parts” ordinarily denotes genitals.
findings.replacement: And on top of that, even when I’m just sitting still, a certain private spot on my backside starts tingling…
findings.source: 게다가 그저 가만히 앉아 있기만 해도 엉덩이의 은밀한 부위가 저릿저릿한 것이…….

findings.current: The middle-aged man rambled on, then saw their expressions and clicked his tongue.
findings.defect: Changes his lip-smacking gesture to a tongue click.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다셨다 describes smacking his lips, not clicking his tongue.
findings.replacement: The middle-aged man rambled on, then saw their expressions and smacked his lips.
findings.source: 주절주절 말을 이어가던 중년인이 사람들의 표정을 보고 입맛을 다셨다.

findings.current: “No, no. I’ll piss right here. I’m sure even Zhuge Wuhou did the same when he was busy.”
findings.defect: Loses the shift from deliberately relieving himself there to wetting himself.
findings.rationale: 지리겠네 means he will wet himself; the earlier 싸지 already supplies the cruder threat to relieve himself on the spot.
findings.replacement: “No need. I’ll just wet myself right here. I’m sure even Zhuge Wuhou did the same when he was busy.”
findings.source: “아니긴 뭘. 그냥 여기에서 지리겠네. 제갈무후(諸葛武侯)께서도 한창 바쁠 때는 그러셨을 거야.”

findings.defect: Adds a request to hear a prayer to an invocation.
findings.rationale: The speaker invokes 천지신명 but makes no request.

summary: The draft preserves the chapter’s main events, but changes the timing of the reinforcements, adds a geographic direction, and misrenders several cues in the final exchange.
